items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-11-18
items.q: I think it's Clark now isn't it? No it's not, Clark is on demand.

ctx.x: You were Catholic in the course?

Yeah Catholic on Arlene Street at the Holy Family. And then later on I went to Byer Road School. It's on Byer Road in Durban. I think it's Clark now isn't it? No it's not, Clark is on demand. I went to Byer Road and then moved to St. Philip Street. Oh yeah. Yeah well that's Craig, it's Craig School now. Byer Road. It was just a big house and across the street where you see all them raised houses, well that was a junior high there. Oh yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Big house. But I had all good teachers and I think my second…
Either band or orchestra or singing or anything? No they didn't. Well I mean like singing, yeah.
